ocr.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Exit immediately if xmllint is not installed
if ! command -v xmllint &> /dev/null; then
    echo "Error: xmllint is not installed. Please install libxml2-utils or libxml2."
    exit 1
fi

# Find all staged .fodp files that are added (A), copied (C), or modified (M)
STAGED_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.fodp$')

# Exit early if no .fodp files are staged
if [ -z "$STAGED_FILES" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

echo "Formatting staged .fodp files..."

for FILE in $STAGED_FILES; do
    if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
        # Format the file in-place using xmllint
        xmllint --format "$FILE" --output "$FILE"

        # Re-add the formatted file to the staging area
        git add "$FILE"
        echo "Formatted and re-staged: $FILE"
    fi
done

exit 0
